items.title: The Price Tag on Jensen Huang’s Resignation: $639 Billion and Counting
items.summary: Nvidia’s market cap tumbled $639.1 billion this week, its worst weekly decline ever. The debate now is whether or not investors want to take advantage of the fall.

items.title: Meta tests prediction-market app for employees, WSJ reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Meta Platforms is testing an internal prediction-market app called Takes, allowing employees to predict the outcomes of events using virtual points rather than real money, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday.

items.title: 3 Favorite Warren Buffett Stocks Hit Record Highs As Nvidia Sinks
items.summary: What unites the three favorite Warren Buffett stocks? Their defensive edge in a market dealing with the shock exit of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Ackman on Huang's Exit, Anthropic IPO Roadshow
items.summary: Bill Ackman, Pershing Square founder and CEO, says it's sad to see Jensen Huang leave Nvidia and he'll go on to do something great. Ackman also says he was impressed with the presentation given by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei at the company's IPO roadshow event in New York. He speaks to Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee.
